title: Example Sentence Bank
description: Schema for a chunked dictionary example sentence file

groupIds.description: Numeric IDs matchable across dictionaries to group sentences (one example can belong to multiple groups). Can be null if the sentence has no group(s).

sentence.description: The complete example sentence. A blank sentence (empty or only whitespace) is skipped; the import warns once with the count.

quality.description: How good an example this sentence is, from 1 (worst) to 100 (best), fractions allowed. Search results are ordered by it, best first. A value outside 1-100 is clamped; the import warns once with the count. Can be null or omitted; the importer then rates the sentence with its text quality model where it supports the sentence's language, and otherwise derives a stable default from the sentence text.

tags.description: List of string tags (e.g., 'slang', 'idiom'). These reference definitions provided in Yomitan tag_bank_*.json files (schema: '../../yomitan/dictionary-tag-bank-v3-schema.json'). Blank tags are ignored.

stats.description: List of numeric stats associated with the sentence (e.g., frequency, JLPT level, difficulty).

source.description: Empty when omitted or null. Either a path to a file inside the archive (played locally) or an http(s) url the data is fetched from at runtime.

tags.description: Tags specific to this audio file (e.g., 'native', 'female'). These map directly to definitions provided in Yomitan tag_bank_*.json files. Blank tags are ignored.

stats.description: Numeric stats specific to this audio file (e.g., clarity score, speed).

statName.description: The backend identifier for the stat (e.g., 'freq', 'JLPT', 'quality').

displayName.description: Optional user-friendly label for the stat (e.g., 'Frequency', 'JLPT Level').

value.description: The strictly numeric value used for sorting/filtering in the database.

displayValue.description: Optional formatted representation of the value (e.g., 'N5', 'uncommon').
